about: Boost Your Business in One Scan.

We provide a wide range of professionally designed products, including Google review QR stands, social media access QR codes, WhatsApp chat QR codes, digital menu QR stands for restaurants and cafés, and payment QR solutions such as JazzCash, Easypaisa, and bank QR codes. Each product is fully customizable with your brand logo, colors, and design preferences, ensuring a polished and professional appearance. Our QR stands and NFC solutions are built to enhance customer engagement, encourage authentic reviews, simplify cashless transactions, and make your business operations more efficient.

At TapScan, we combine innovation, quality, and reliability. All orders are carefully processed and produced based on your specifications, then delivered nationwide through trusted courier services. We are committed to transparency, providing clear information about shipping, customization options, and after-sales support. Our dedicated team is always available to assist with inquiries, ensuring every customer receives a smooth and satisfying experience.

We believe that every business, regardless of size, deserves access to simple yet powerful digital tools. TapScan’s solutions are designed to bridge the gap between offline interactions and online engagement, allowing businesses to transform customer experiences in seconds. Whether you want more reviews, more social media followers, or easier cashless payments, TapScan makes it possible with just one scan.

Our vision is to make digital transformation accessible for all Pakistani businesses. By leveraging QR code and NFC technology, we aim to create smarter, faster, and more connected business environments across the country. We help businesses not only improve customer engagement but also increase operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and long-term growth.
